It was another day like any other. Ottys and Cream were scavenging for something they could feed on. The food was gone, they had to go find more and supply the shelter. Vegetables, fruits, nuts, anything was fine. Cream was looking around while Ottys kept watch to see that no predators were around.

Cream then sees something flashy, it was an apple tree, his favorite "Oh wow... I can't believe it! Apples this time of year? We must be lucky today!" He exclaims excitedly, running towards the tree, trying to lean on a rock and try to get the apples.
Ottys looks at his brother going towards the tree and sighs "Cream... This tree is too big, you won't be able to get the apples..." He says in his usual serious tone, he knew it wasn't worth it, rabbits couldn't climb.
"Don't be so pessimistic Ottys! I've seen squirrels do that..!" He says trying to climb the huge tree but it was useless, he couldn't.
"Until the last time I checked, you weren't a squirrel" Ottys says sarcastically, just crossing his arms and waiting for his brother to give up.
